data.title: First reminder: Muster Magazin subscription
data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) for the unpaid annual fee of the "Muster Magazin" subscription. The total to pay is €61.90, due by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: The publisher says your annual subscription fee of €59.40 is still unpaid and has added a reminder fee of €2.50. Please transfer €61.90 to the account named in the letter by 30 June 2025. If you have already paid, the letter says you can ignore it. If you don't pay, further reminders or collection steps may follow, although the letter doesn't say so. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the publisher's reader service.
